messages:
elaine.s: Quick heads-up — we’re gating a coordinated base-image refresh tonight at 22:00 PT. Scope: runtime pool (gpu/standard), minimal packages, cosign signing with rotated key. Need checklist on RBAC changes and audit forwarding before cutover.
pranjal: +1. Which key are we rotating? the org-wide signing key or a per-environment one?
elaine.s: per-env. plan is: create new signer key per-prod-cluster, promote, re-sign new images, then retire old key. We want least-privileged signer role for the CI job.
samir: for audit, we should ensure KMS key operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/AsymmetricSign) are traced and go to our secure-audit sink. Splunk ingestion existing pipeline?
lina: splunk -> yes. I’ll add a filter for kms.keyVersion.* events. Also we must add an inbound filter for cosign attestations so we don’t drop them.
elaine.s: thx. RBAC ask: CI needs iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on the signer-sa and iam.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign for the new key. Can we scope to the key resource?
pranjal: yes scope to resource path. Example IAM: "roles/cloudkms.signer" is too broad; better create a custom role with only cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.sign and storage.objectViewer for image blob read.
pranjal: also remember to block broad iam:serviceAccountKeyCreate for signer-sa — we want no long-lived keys.
samir: good call. For runtime nodes: after new image rollout, agents will contact key server for certs. Ensure node role doesn't have sign permission, only verify.
elaine.s: agreed. nodes only need public-key verify. sign only lives in CI signer pipeline and ops-oncall-signer.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: PREP -> create-key, grant-role, update CI job, smoke sign test. CUTOVER -> canary 5 nodes, watch SLOs. POST -> rotate kubelet tokens, expire old key.
lina: permission matrix draft: signer-sa -> custom-sign-role on key. ci-runner -> signer-sa impersonate (iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken). ops-oncall -> keyRotation role. runtime-node-sa -> iam.cloudkms.viewer + image-verify role.
elaine.s: Can someone draft the minimal custom role YML and a short terraform snippet for key resource and binding? I’ll need it for the change request.
pranjal: I’ll drop a snippet here in a sec.
pranjal: ```hcl
resource "google_kms_key_ring" "images" {
  name = "images-${var.env}"
}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "signer" {
  name     = "image-signer"
  key_ring = google_kms_key_ring.images.id
}
resource "google_service_account" "signer_sa" {
  account_id   = "image-signer-${var.env}"
}
resource "google_project_iam_member" "signer_bind" {
  role   = "roles/cloudkms.signer" # replace with custom role
  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.signer_sa.email}"
}
```
pranjal: replace roles/cloudkms.signer with the custom role we discussed.
lina: that’s fine. I’ll convert to minimal IAM and push to the infra PR.
samir: vuln triage note — the current intermediate image has libssl flagged. We are rebuilding onto a newer distro baseline that fixes the CVE but keep an eye on compatibility tests. If failing, fallback plan is to pin old libssl + mitigate via seccomp ingress until patched.
elaine.s: fallback acknowledged. Add this to the incident-runbook reference. Also reminder: cosign attestation must be attached to image metadata before we promote. No unsigned images allowed in prod pool.
signer-bot: cosign signer v2: signature created for image: gcr.io/redwood/prod/runtime:2026-03-21-rc1
ops-bot: canary deploy started for pool gpu-prod-canary (5 nodes). Monitor: request latency, token refresh errors, audit events.
lina: watching audit stream — I see keyVersion.create and IAM binding apply events. tagging them with ticket INFRA-4523.
elaine.s: if anything unexpected with iam.apply or key access appears, abort canary and rollback images. Samir, liaise with oncall if unexpected crashes spiked.
samir: I’ll keep pager on. Also will run quick replay of attestation verify script against canary images.
elaine.s: perfect. Post-mortem stub: include decision logs for key rotation timing, RBAC policy diffs, and vuln watchlist. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
